chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Hamdan al-Mukattab narrated to us. He said: Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Isa al-Damaghani narrated to us. He said: Yahya ibn al-Mughira narrated to us. He said: Jarir narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Atiyya, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

On the night I was taken on my heavenly journey, Gabriel took my hand and admitted me into Paradise, and seated me upon a carpet from the carpets of Paradise. Then he handed me a quince, and it split into two halves, and there emerged from it a dark-eyed beauty whose eyelashes were like the front feathers of eagles. She said: 'Peace be upon you, O Ahmad. Peace be upon you, O Messenger of God. Peace be upon you, O Muhammad.' I said: 'Who are you, may God have mercy on you?' She said: 'I am the satisfied one whom Allah is satisfied with (al-Radiyya al-Mardiyya). The Powerful created me from three substances: my lower part is from musk, my upper part is from camphor, and my middle is from ambergris, and I was kneaded with the water of life. The Majestic said: Be! And I became. I was created for your cousin, your deputy, and your vizier, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.الراضية المرضية: Al-Radiyya al-Mardiyya - the satisfied one whom God is pleased with, echoing Quran 89:28
key_terms.حوراء: Hawra - a houri, a dark-eyed beauty of Paradise described in Islamic eschatology
key_terms.درنوك: Durnuk - a thick carpet or cushioned rug, a rare word indicating luxurious furnishing in Paradise
key_terms.سفرجلة: Safarjala - quince fruit, mentioned in prophetic traditions as a fruit of Paradise
key_terms.ماء الحيوان: Ma' al-Hayawan - the water of life, a concept of life-giving divine water

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the houri created for Ali ibn Abi Talib during the Night Journey?
ai.summary: This hadith is a prophetic narration about the Night Journey (Isra' and Mi'raj) in which the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) recounts an encounter in Paradise with a heavenly maiden (houri) who emerged from a quince fruit. She identified herself as 'al-Radiyya al-Mardiyya' (the satisfied one, the one pleasing to God) and described her miraculous creation from musk, camphor, and ambergris mixed with the water of life. She declared that she was specifically created for Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS), whom she described as the Prophet's cousin, deputy (wasi), and vizier. The hadith was narrated through the companion Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and is characteristic of the genre of fada'il (virtues) literature highlighting the special status of Imam Ali.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Hamdan al-Mukattab narrated to us. He said: Abu `Abdullah Muhammad b. `Abd al-Rahman al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Isa al-Damaghani. He said: Yahya b. al-Mughira narrated to us. He said: Jarir narrated to us from al-A`mash from `Atiyya from Abi Sa`id al-Khudri. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

On the night that I was taken to the heavens, Gabriel took my hand and sat me down on a carpet from the carpets of Paradise. He handed me a quince, and when I split it in half, a dark-eyed beauty appeared; the edges of her eyes were like the front feathers of an eagle. So, she said: “Peace be unto you, O Ahmad. Peace be unto you, O Messenger of Allah. Peace be unto you, O Muhammad.” So, I said: “Who are you – may Allah have mercy on you?” She said: “I am the satisfied one whom Allah is satisfied with (radiyatan mardiyya). The Powerful created me from three substances: the undermost of me is from musk, the middle of me is from camphor, the uppermost of me is from ambergris, and I have been kneaded from the water of life. The Powerful said ‘be!’ and I became. He created me for your cousin, your deputy, and your vizier `Ali b. Abi Talib (as).”
